ShieldOfFaith.description: When a friendly <style="Rarity_Mythic">Mythic</style> <style="Character">character</style> <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crits</style> or attacks an enemy that is on a hex with <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style>, it gains a <style="Buff_Shield">Shield</style> until the start of its next turn, unless it already has a shield. The shield's <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> is <style="STAT">{[shieldPct]}%</style> of the affected character's maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.
